Boundscenter: Centre of the proxy box in the geometry's object space.
Boundssize: Size (X, Y, Z) of the proxy box in object space. The geometry should be a box covering it; rays start on its surface.
Maxsteps: Maximum raymarch steps per pixel. Higher = more accurate on thin or distant shapes, slower.
Epsilon: Surface hit distance. Smaller = sharper but may need more steps.
Stepscale: Multiplier on each march step. Below 1 is safer for inexact SDFs, but needs more steps.
Lightazimuth: Direction of the built-in key light around the vertical axis, in degrees.
Lightelevation: Height of the built-in key light above the horizon, in degrees.
Shadows: Shadow hardness. Higher = sharper shadows, 0 = no shadows.
Gamma: Output gamma. 2.2 = standard sRGB-like, 1 = linear output.
